lessons.title: Keeping Up with Science: Brain Cells That Keep You Motivated (C1)
grammar: Use inversion (Negative adverb + auxiliary + subject + verb) for sophisticated scientific discourse (e.g., Not only do these neurons fire during goal setting, but they also sustain effort).
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-DSC-C1-001"
cando: "I can discuss 'Brain Cells That Keep You Motivated' and support my opinion with evidence."
